subtopic: Best Interest Obligations and Conflicts of Interest
source_evidence: Investment advisers are required to act in your best interest and not put their interest ahead of yours. At the same time, the way advisers make money creates some conflicts with your interests.
answer: An investment adviser must act in your best interest and not put the adviser’s interests ahead of yours. However, how an adviser is paid can create conflicts of interest that may affect the advice they give. This obligation does not mean conflicts cannot exist, so ask the adviser about potential conflicts and how they relate to the services and fees involved.
